domain: Circuit codes of spread k (k-coils): longest induced cycle in the hypercube Q_d with Hamming(x,x') >= min(cycle_distance(x,x'), k)
metric_note: coil length N = #edges = #vertices = #transitions (cyclic). Higher is better.
verified: 2026-07-07 (research cross-check: Byrnes 2017 Table 3 = Hood et al. 2015 on all k>=3 cells; closed-form theorems confirm the proven_optimal frontier).
definition: An (d,k) circuit code is a simple cycle C in Q_d such that for any two vertices x,x' on C, d_Hamming(x,x') >= min(d_C(x,x'), k) where d_C = distance along the cycle. Spread 2 = coil-in-the-box. Snake (open path) is a DIFFERENT, ~(k-1)-shorter table - do not cross-reference.

conventions.coil_vs_snake: coil = closed cycle (this table); snake = open induced path (separate table). Modern usage: snake=open, coil=closed (pre-2000 papers inverted this).
conventions.length: coil = vertices = edges = transitions; snake = edges = vertices - 1
